Delhi Police arrest 3 Lawrence Bishnoi gang shooters planning targeted killings

Delhi Police's Special Staff arrested three shooters linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. The shooters were allegedly planning targeted killings and were wanted in previous incidents. The arrests are part of increased scrutiny of the gang's organized crime network. One report mentioned a foreign network was exposed.
